items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: you went down to try to see the Mayor

ctx.x: Oh, I'm around. I'm playing some gigs. I play some parties for people. I do that, and I get a little ...(?)...
Well, I know you were telling me yesterday that you went down to try to see the Mayor about an old firehouse or something.

Yeah. I have some kids I've been working with the last nine years. The Fairview Baptist Church Christian(?) Band, which is kids who are musically inclined, and Lucien and me and Charlie Barbarin, we have two sons... That's mostly why I got involved with it. Lucien and Charlie Barbarin, we were teaching them traditional music, which was the beginning -- some people call it Dixieland here, but I don't know what "Dixieland" is.
